scripts.build: NODE_ENV=development CI=true npx pnpm@9.15.9 install --no-frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && chmod -R +x node_modules/.pnpm 2>/dev/null || true && NODE_ENV=production npx pnpm@9.15.9 --filter @workspace/accounting-app run build && npx pnpm@9.15.9 --filter @workspace/api-server run build && mkdir -p tmp && touch tmp/restart.txt
